name: Dynamic hero: diagonal gradient, skewed badges, clipped action photo
notes: Original build for the library, not adapted from a client site — built for a startup/fitness/events-type brand that wants to feel fast rather than trustworthy-and-steady. Every skewed element (badges, buttons, media tag) uses the same -8deg transform with an inner un-skewed span so the text itself stays readable — copy that exact pattern rather than skewing text directly, which garbles it. The clip-path on .hero__media only applies above 900px; below that it's a plain full-width image, since an angled clip on a short mobile viewport just crops the photo awkwardly. Three-stop diagonal gradient (violet→magenta→orange) is the accent system here instead of a single accent color — keep all three stops if reusing, dropping to two reads flatter and less 'in motion.'
